name: Trieu Nguyen
role: Lab Manager · Life Science Research Professional
focus: Human coronary artery SMC models, iPSCs and CRISPR editing
bio: Trieu received her BS in biology from UC San Diego. She has extensive experience with human induced pluripotent stem cells and CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing, and is an expert in human coronary artery smooth muscle cell models used to study the role of transcription factors in coronary artery disease.
